description: This file defines the QuicConnectionId class and QuicConnectionIdHasher class used in the QUIC protocol implementation for managing connection IDs, including hashing, comparison, and string conversion functionalities.

classes.name: QuicConnectionIdHasher
classes.description: A hasher class for generating stable hash values for connection IDs within a process lifetime.

classes.name: QuicConnectionId
classes.description: Represents a QUIC connection ID with methods for data access, comparison, hashing, and string conversion.

methods.name: QuicConnectionIdHasher()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the hasher with a random key.

methods.name: QuicConnectionIdHasher(QuicRandom* random)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the hasher with a provided QuicRandom instance.

methods.name: Hash(const char* input, size_t input_len) const
methods.description: Computes a SIPHASH-24 hash of the input data.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId()
methods.description: Default constructor for QuicConnectionId.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId(const char* data, uint8_t length)
methods.description: Constructs a QuicConnectionId from raw data and length.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId(const absl::Span<const uint8_t> data)
methods.description: Constructs a QuicConnectionId from an absl::Span of bytes.

methods.name: ~QuicConnectionId()
methods.description: Destructor that frees allocated memory if necessary.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId(const QuicConnectionId& other)
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.name: operator=(const QuicConnectionId& other)
methods.description: Assignment operator.

methods.name: data() const
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the connection ID data.

methods.name: mutable_data()
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the connection ID data.

methods.name: length() const
methods.description: Returns the length of the connection ID.

methods.name: set_length(uint8_t length)
methods.description: Sets the length of the connection ID, resizing internal storage as needed.

methods.name: IsEmpty() const
methods.description: Checks if the connection ID is empty.

methods.name: Hash() const
methods.description: Returns a hash value for the connection ID.

methods.name: ToString() const
methods.description: Returns a hex string representation of the connection ID.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream& os, const QuicConnectionId& v)
methods.description: Stream output operator for QuicConnectionId.

methods.description: Equality comparison.

methods.description: Inequality comparison.

methods.description: Less-than comparison.
